question: Does the P0560 negative-boundary trend saturate, reverse, or become topologically unstable within the actual elliptic range of the measured tensors?
interpretation: post-P0560 optimizer-stability and extended-range diagnostic on spent systems; never independent validation and never formula promotion
coupling_bound_reason: the measured maximum |Q| is below 0.15 in every map, so |t|<=6 leaves every eigenvalue of I+tQ positive

ellipticity.rule: require 1-|t| max|Q| > 0.05 separately for every physical cluster map

response_checks.leave_one_system_out_selection: minimum equal-system exact RMS on the other three, root-complete candidates only

claim_limits: The range and denser optimizer audit were chosen after seeing P0560; this is an explicitly post-hoc response diagnostic.
All four systems have already influenced the research program and provide no independent validation.
A per-system optimum diagnoses compatibility but is not an allowed model parameter.
Positive ellipticity is a mathematical well-posedness gate, not evidence that large coupling is physically valid.
No formula can be promoted from P0561.
